notes.title: Development Status Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Current Game Status[/h1]
As of now, the game stands in the following state:

[list]
[*] Stable and fully playable.
[*] Through Steam's branch feature, you can experience two entirely distinct versions.
[*] The current version experiences some performance issues in the later stages of Mars terraforming. Unrestrained expansion of your base can lead to significant frame rate drops.
[*] Most MODs from the Steam Workshop are functional, but be cautious as some may conflict, preventing game saves. In such instances, removing the buildings and units added by conflicting MODs and uninstalling those mods may salvage your saves.
[/list]

[h1]Reshaping Mars' Development Journey[/h1]
The development of Reshaping Mars spanned three and a half years, commencing in early 2020, and it was introduced to early access in August 2021. At that juncture, it was a Mars terraforming game characterized by a hexagonal grid and a macro perspective.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/e483272b6a4e4788f8a54c4db5c8787c97c85a1d.gif[/img]


Towards the end of 2021, I released a free DLC for this version: "The Rise of Locke Industries," which introduced the playable faction "Locke Industries" and a new storyline, the "AI Crisis." At this point, Reshaping Mars played like a macro-strategy combined with real-time strategy (RTS).
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/0b2d843d63402101aeb1dead28a89035d2290a9d.png[/img]

Subsequently, a slew of new ideas sprouted within me. I envisioned players exploring a full-scale Mars, diverging from the hexagonal chessboard. This vision led to the complete restructuring of the gameplay. In essence, apart from minimal artistic assets and reused music, this became an entirely new game.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/9e259219332a0cd72a283dbe0aeae55ef18b6e5c.jpg[/img]

This endeavor consumed a year and a half of my time. In late 2022, I initiated testing for the new version, which was officially released in March 2023, marking the conclusion of the early access phase.

The new iteration of Reshaping Mars shifts away from the macro perspective. Players are now akin to commanders of a base, tasked with constructing a thriving Martian city and utilizing it to eco-engineer the planet.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/352b883db46fa75bdc11bbef28c42a56e00a07a3.gif[/img]

[h1]My Current Situation[/h1]
The number of reviews can provide insight into Reshaping Mars' sales performance. Frankly speaking, considering three years of development and accounting for various revenue shares, it hasn't yielded a particularly robust commercial return. Moreover, it fails to provide the necessary support for me to continue crafting new content for Reshaping Mars.

During restless nights, I often contemplate whether I should have adhered to the early access version's trajectory instead of revamping the entire gameplay. I ponder whether launching a separate game with the new gameplay framework might yield better commercial returns.

I also ponder the many players who hold fondness for the older version and question whether I've wholly disappointed their expectations.

Overthinking may not alter the reality. I console myself with the fact that I've laid bare my full imaginative vision of terraforming Mars to you all. Through the steam branch feature, you can experience these two vastly different versions, and that should suffice.

[h1]Thanks and Apologies[/h1]
Some words are difficult to articulate, but certain circumstances necessitate candor: Reshaping Mars will temporarily transition into an inactive state. There won't be new content updates for the game in the near future. If you're curious about the game's playability and whether it's worth purchasing, please refer to the beginning of this article.

Thank you to all the players who have purchased the game or participated in testing; this is your greatest support to me.

I extend my heartfelt gratitude to the community friends who have accompanied me on this journey. Your encouragement and suggestions have held significant meaning for me.

To friends who have been eagerly awaiting updates, I offer my sincerest apologies for falling short of your expectations. I express my deepest regret here.

The script code for this game can be found under game\default_game\static_db\package, while the UI code resides in game\default_game\ui\script. These are Lua scripts that I hope will be of assistance to anyone interested in game development.

[h1]Future Plans[/h1]
Reshaping Mars marked my inaugural independent game development endeavor. Creating this game was akin to embarking on an adventure, and I'm grateful to have had your companionship along the way.

As previously mentioned, Reshaping Mars represents my first independent game creation, but by no means is it the last. I'm already in the early stages of conceptualizing a new game project, poised to embark on this fresh journey shortly.

I intend for this project to have a shorter development timeline, certainly not spanning three years or even an additional year and a half. My aspiration is for this project to yield more substantial financial stability. With this, I can indulge in certain endeavors, much like I did when I embarked on creating the new version of Reshaping Mars.

The following words don't constitute promises, but I nevertheless hold hope for their realization: "Terraforming Mars is humanity's most likely monumental achievement in the near future. Both the community and I harbor countless lofty dreams for Reshaping Mars. When I possess the budget and resources necessary, I'll be more than willing to reinitiate this project and bring these exciting ideas to life."

notes.title: RESHAPING MARS Full Release Out Now!
notes.notes:
Greetings !

       RESHAPING MARS is officially out of early access today! 

      After more than three years of development and a year and a half of Early-access stage, the official version of RESHAPING MARS can finally meet with you!
Excited heart, trembling hands, friends who saw this announcement, let me introduce you:


[h2]Game Content[/h2]

       You will build, mine, and explore on real-sized Mars. On the vast land of Mars, construct, mine, research, and explore; and finally transform it into a livable planet for humans.

       In addition, you can also unlock more game modes, and do it again with different backstories.

       For more details, click here :
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1395760/view/6033168248063355676

[hr][/hr]

[h2]Legacy Version[/h2]

       RESHAPING MARS also has a legacy version, which is a Mars transformation game with a completely different gameplay.

       The legacy version is a  game with a story and a more macro perspective. Transforming Mars on a hexagonal grid map. In the last few screenshots of the store page, you can see what this legacy version looked like.

       In the player reviews page, the reviews before January 15, 2023 are from the legacy version.
       In the achievement system, the fatter trophy belongs to the legacy version of the achievement.

       You can also experience this legacy version at any time, use the branch feature provided by Steam, and switch to the branch named [Legacy].

       In other words, [b][u][i] buy one RESHAPING MARS, you will have two Mars transformation games with very different gameplay. [/i][/u][/b]


[hr][/hr]
[h2]Near Future[/h2]

       I have received countless ideas and inspirations from the community. Under the current gameplay framework, there are still many interesting elements that can continue to be added.

       I also know that it is difficult to incorporate all the good suggestions in the community with the power of my own development.

       Therefore, I will give priority to the work of opening the Steam workshop in the near future, hoping that this will allow RESHAPING MARS to carry more content.


[hr][/hr]

[h2]Special Thanks[/h2]
       I wanted to take a moment to express my heartfelt gratitude for all of your support during the development and early-access stages of RESHAPING MARS. As a non-native English speaker, I understand that my language skills may not be perfect, and I hope that you can understand and bear with any mistakes in the translations.

If you have any concerns or disagreements with the translation or any other aspect of the game, please don't hesitate to share your thoughts with me. I am always eager to listen to your feedback, and I promise to do my best to address any issues that may arise.

Your support, suggestions, feedback, and reviews have been invaluable to me in improving the game and reaching this point of official release. I am deeply grateful for the opportunity to share this journey with you, and I look forward to continuing to build this game with you all in the future.

       At the same time, for the friends who see here, I am also looking forward to creating interesting memories of Mars with you in the future.



[h1]GET IT NOW AT 20% OFF:[/h1]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1395760

[hr][/hr]
       If you encounter any problems or suggestions during the game, please feel free to post in the community forum or join [url=https://discord.gg/XYCW8W3GhZ]discord[/url], I will listen to your feedback attentively.


       Wish you have fun~🚀

notes.title: [Minor Update] New aircraft: Explosive miner, New skill: Reactor Explosion, etc.
notes.notes:
Greetings~ There are some new contents in these two days, mainly including the following:

[h3]New Content[/h3]
[list]
[*] New unit: Explosive Miner. Mining in a more violent way.
[*] New ability: Nuclear Crusher's Reactor Explosion.
[*] Numeric Adjustment: Greatly reduced Crusher and Nuclear Crusher material requirements.
[*] New Satellites: One-time Probe Beacon Bundle. Launch once, explore many times.
[*] New displayment: NxN size value will be displayed when selecting an area with any command.
[/list]

[h3]Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improved operating experience when the swipe command is on the edge of the map.
[*] When there is no pipe connected, the prompt of insufficient pipeline supplies will not be displayed.
[*] Added a progress bar to the production interface and highlighted the production items. It is convenient to check the current production status.
[*] When the Logistics Hub is full, the transporter will wait for the empty space in the Logistics Hub instead of continuing to go back to the start position with a full load.
[*] After the blueprint material is full, the unit will start building immediately instead of waiting for the next unit to execute.
[*] Optimize the charging logic of work units and bionics to reduce charging queues.
[*] Planting settings for farm buildings can also be copied and pasted.
[*] The Logistics Hub can also take water directly from the water tank.
[*] When right-clicking and dragging, the cancel operation will not be performed.
[*] Reduce the frequency of notifications in the upper right corner, so as not to be disturbed by frequent notification sounds.
[*] You can check the number of work units in the region by hovering the mouse over the control seat label.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixing[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where commands would sometimes be incorrectly placed on the map.
[/list]

Wish you all a happy mining and have fun~

notes.title: With 99% brand new and free game content, here I come!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I am back with a brand new "Reshaping Mars"!

As usual, let's cut to the chase and see what the new version has to offer.

[h3][i][b]Short answer:

The new version equals A brand new Mars colony simulation game, updated for free to everyone who bought this game.[/b][/i][/h3]



Long answer:

[h1] Full-size map of Mars[/h1]

You can land anywhere on Mars and start a big infrastructure.

Pay attention to different parameters such as altitude, light, wind, season, resource abundance, etc., which will affect your base development strategy.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/bb82fe2463a186d9b61fb580656e137c3738b11f.gif[/img]

[h1]Destroyable Terrain[/h1]

If you dig a mine, it leaves a pit. You can flatten a mountain or fill a crater into a plain.

Not enough wind? Then fill out a mountain with enough wind power.

No more mines? Then dig down a layer of land, there is always a surprise waiting for you.

If you dig deep enough, or fill high enough; your masterpiece can be seen in space. This ...... may be the ...... wonder?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/6a96c77a3300dccde2506905782046dd96c0e1e9.gif[/img]

[h1]More Pure Simulation[/h1]

From now on, there are no more various pop-up events.

You only focus on the prosperity of your base: are the factories working, are there any shortages of supplies, are the inhabitants happy, is the water and power supply still enough.

You may also be concerned: how are the engineering vehicles working in faraway places, have they been left in the mine pits, are there still enough charging posts on their roads, do I need to build a road that will run faster.

Maybe you also wonder: should we call a group of residents to enhance productivity? Is there enough food for everyone at the moment, how much supply is left in the market, and how much surplus food is left in the warehouse.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/637693582e4f82c92fff565fa841e775ff96f0ac.gif[/img]

[h1]Open-ended transformation of the planet[/h1]

There is no one task that requires you to do this or that. The planet's air pressure, temperature, radiation, and oceans are all dynamic indicators that interact with each other.

When you are sure your base is running steadily, then open the terraforming interface and see what else we need to do to terraform Mars.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/352b883db46fa75bdc11bbef28c42a56e00a07a3.gif[/img]

[h1]There's More[/h1]

As you can see, I'm talking about this, and it's actually pretty much the same as the description on the store page. Because I am really introducing a brand new game to you.

If you're interested, then don't listen to my nonsense, just get the latest version and start the new "Reshaping Mars" journey~.



Finally, if you still want to continue to play the old version, use the branch switching feature provided by Steam, the old version I kept it all on the branch called "Legacy".



I hope you will like the new version of "Reshaping Mars", and happy gaming everyone~

notes.title: 【Dev Log June】 New Content，Maps and Gameplay
notes.notes:
[h1][/h1]Greetings!

Hi everyone, I'm Tholus, the developer of Reshaping Mars.

I've been working on the new version of Reshaping Mars these days, and it's been a long time since I made the last announcement.

At present, the new version has made remarkable progress. So, I think it is a good time to come out and share with you some great changes in the new version of Reshaping Mars.

[b][u]Before that, I would like to state that all images are from temporary art resources and do not represent the final quality of the new version.[/u][/b]

Let's get straight to the point!

[h1]Full-size Mars map[/h1]

You can explore and develop every corner of Mars, and the resources, wind, sunshine, and temperature changes in various places will affect your planning strategy.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/4b17ef1e41cfaae720552a87ec20737a44700536.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/c00b05b58220e60175842c973684fca64a177cf0.png[/img]

[h1]Removing mountains and filling seas[/h1]

The mountain is annoying? Turn it into some minerals! The coastline is not spacious enough? Fill up the sea to build a factory!

In the new version, most of your development will change the planet's appearance. How can you say that you have reshaped Mars without leveling a few hills?


[h1]Sea level, atmosphere, and temperature[/h1]

You have to carefully control the composition of the atmosphere and temperature and try to make the Martian atmosphere comparable to the composition of the Earth. Otherwise, you may get an ice planet or a pressure cooker Mars. Your inhabitants won't be able to take off their protective suits and respirators and run carefree under the Martian sunset.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/102e1b770f5e8c5557c4114e28e2796efbac6306.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38665722/b72c23acdc4c92c4c0feeea9422b730a1d066332.png[/img]


[h1]More content[/h1]

There are also many new gameplays and contents, such as new resource collection, resident demand management, market economy system, etc. I am still polishing these gameplays. As soon as there is any gratifying progress, I will definitely report to you here!

[h1]To sum up……[/h1]

A whole new version of Reshaping Mars is almost done! Looking forward to the day when the new version comes out!

notes.title: A Completely New Gameplay - What's Next In Reshaping Mars?
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I'm Tholus, the developer of Reshaping Mars.

I expect that in the next version, the core of the game will be completely reworked, which will bring a bunch of changes to the gameplay.



[h2]Why do this?[/h2]

The current version is playable and fun, but not enough.

The original update plan was to add new factions,  stories and units. but! These are far from taking the gameplay to a higher level.

I wanted the gameplay and content of Reshaping Mars to have a higher ceiling, so I decided to redo the core of the game.



[h2] What will it be like?[/h2]

In general, it is still a base-building game, with some RTS gameplay.

But the operation of the base will be more layered and detailed than at present. Management will also highlight the "human" factor.

In addition, there will be a whole new story, and it will no longer be presented in the current annoying pop-up form.

There are also brand new logistics systems, humanities systems, etc... Since the design is not yet fully finalized, and the necessary mystery, that's all I can say for now.



[h2] I want to keep playing the old version, what should I do?[/h2]

No problem, in the next version, I'll give you options. The default is the new gameplay mode.

If you want to continue to play the old archive, you can choose the old mode (that is the mode that everyone is currently playing).



[h2] So, when will it be available?[/h2]

It is expected that beta-testing will be open in 3-4 months.



[h2] At last[/h2]

This version will take a long time to make, and I will try to update the dev log regularly. I'm a person who can't hold back secrets. Once I do something, I can't wait to tell you guys!

notes.title: TGS Discount & Next Major Version Preview: The Ambitions of Locke Conglomerate
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, I am Tholus. <Reshaping Mars> has been with you for more than a month. Thanks for all your support! At the same time, I also received a lot of valuable feedback and suggestions from the [url=https://discord.gg/XYCW8W3GhZ]discord[/url] channel and the forum, which is exactly what I need in the EA stage! I will report to the commanders to explain the main content of the next major version of Reshaping Mars:
[h1]Summary[/h1]
[list]
[*] Make all operations more macro, reducing the current mouse-consuming experience.
[*] Added a new playable force: Locke Conglomerate.
[/list]

[h1]Detailed description[/h1]

[h2]Leader[/h2]
In the next update, you can delegate many complicated things to leaders, and they will manage their own jurisdictions well.
And you, as the highest commander, only need to make the most decisions on the most important things.

[h2]Pop-ups[/h2]
There will no longer be frequent pop-ups to interfere with the construction of your Mars base.
Those less important things will be stored in the corner of the screen. Only those things you really need to care about will give you a pop-up window.


[h2]Locke Conglomerate[/h2]
[h3]New Story[/h3]
You will experience a period on earth with Martin of Locke Conglomerate... well, maybe not that unforgettable time.

[h3]New Playable Force[/h3]
Locke Conglomerate has completely different construction, unit, and operational characteristics. You can choose to control the Locke Conglomerate and show its grand plans on Mars!

[h2]Performance optimization[/h2]
Even if you are a construction fanatics, refers to players who are crazy about expanding their base by constructing buildings and decorations , you can ensure that the frame rate is in a playable state when the entire map is built in the later stage. Hmm... at least my computer five or six years ago can have more than 30 frames.
In addition, the next version will also optimize the response speed of the camera when moving the camera in the case of a large number of buildings and units in the later stage. When the camera is moved quickly, it should...not feel like a card.

[h2]Custom shortcuts[/h2]
Finally, the custom shortcut keys are arranged on the schedule. However, it can also be seen that compared to the above items, this feature does not seem to be that attractive, at best it is a small optimization. Therefore, it was ranked last (escape...)

[h1]Summarize[/h1]
The above is the main update of the next major version. I'm currently working hard to make it. Due to the large amount of content, the specific release time is still uncertain, but it'll be coming out soon, within 1-2 months, after all, the project folders have been built!
Finally, thanks again for your support for <Reshaping Mars>, and welcome to discuss the great cause of Mars in the forum and [url=https://discord.gg/XYCW8W3GhZ]Discord[/url]. <Reshapig Mars> is becoming better because of you!

notes.notes:
Hello everyone, I am Tholus. I'm glad that you came to play my game!

Since the game launched yesterday, I have received a lot of suggestions and feedback, as well as a lot of bugs. Thank you for all the feedback. I also wanna say sorry to the players who have encountered the bug and have had a bad experience!

So far, a dozen small patches have been updated, mainly to fix the problem of error reporting in some individual cases.

In addition, there is a situation that may cause all the units to freezing or be delayed: when you have a lot of surveying vehicles with automatic surveying on, and if they get stuck in an unreachable position after measuring the end of the world, it may cause other units to get stuck. Pathfinding is stuck and delayed. At present, you can alleviate this lag situation by turning off their automatic surveying function. Of course, I will seize the time to fix this problem as soon as possible. I am very sorry for this situation.


At last, Thank you again for your support and understanding, and hope that Reshaping Mars will bring you a different journey of exploring Mars.

notes.title: Early Access Launch!
notes.notes:
Reshaping Mars is available on Steam now！

About myself
I am Tholus, the producer of Reshaping Mars. As an indie developer, I never imagined that one day my game, which I developed on my own computer at home with four cats of mine, would release on Steam stage. Thanks very much for your support.


4X-game is one of my favorite genres, and I hope you'll give me your feedback as you try out Reshaping Mars on Steam. Your suggestions have been a great motivator for my game development in the future. 

Is there any multiplayer mode for this game?
No, there's no such plan.

Does the game support creative workshops?
Not for now, but will do in the future.

What languages does the game support?
As you can see, only Simplified Chinese and English are currently supported. Sorry to those who use Traditional Chinese, we thought it would be easier to add Tranditional Chinese, but the font we are using has very poor support for Traditional Chinese, so we are not able to fully support it for now, but we will update it soon after we launch.

Tholus

notes.title: Mars colonization game will release on July 29.
notes.notes:
One-person created Mars-themed strategy game Reshaping Mars will launch on Steam July 29th. 

Reshaping Mars will make its first debut to E3 meeting players throughout the world along with its publisher Yooreka Studio, and it will participate the upcoming Steam Next Fest to give players a hands-on for free. 

[h1]About Reshaping Mars[/h1]
[list]
[*] In this game, you will start from scratch to obtain minerals and energy from Mars, build a hydroponic farm to store food, build habitats to accept batches of immigrants.

[*] This is not enough. The harsh environment on Mars will bring a lot of trouble to your colony. Low air pressure, high radiation, large sandstorms, etc. There is no future in dealing with various natural disasters.

[*] Therefore, you need to research more powerful technologies, build more powerful colonies, and then perform some surgery on Mars to make it more livable and you'll become the real master of Mars.
[*] Besides, there are stories and troubles where there are people. With the increasing colonial population, they have their own joys and sorrows, and they will also have various needs. If you ignore them, you are afraid that one day they will ruin the great future of Mars.

[*] So, you need to build living and entertainment facilities, promulgate various welfare policies, and provide residents with all-around convenience for food, clothing, housing, transportation. When people have a happy life, the colony has a bright future, and the entire Mars Reshaping will be meaningful. 
[/list]


[h1]New Gameplay Announcement [/h1]
[list]
[*] The new demo will come with diplomacy gameplay. While you are in full swing building our second home on Mars, there’s other group of people who don’t want the same thing as you 

[*] When economic depression and political crisis facing the United Nations, will the leaders still support Mars development? 

[*] When new military power arises and sweeps the land with force, will their ambition escalate to Mars? 

[*] In the meantime, mysterious unconnected drones are mining secretly in an attempt to build a machinery armed force. Will they be our friends or enemies? Will they acknowledge us as earth creator? 

[*] As the commander in chief of Reshaping Mars project, you will take the lead of your people to find answer with the new diplomacy system. Maybe you will bear with it and make compromise for the greater good; or maybe you will take the challenge and accept war. No matter what decision you will make, people on Mars will always support you. Don’t let them down and lead them to prosperity. 
[/list]

notes.title: Next Version Preview
notes.notes:
Hi everyone, during the steam game festival, I collected a lot of feedback. 
Thank you all for your enthusiasm and encouragement. Also, because of you, Reshaping Mars has a chance to get better.

Next, is the new content that will be brought in the next major version:

[olist]
[*] Brand new UI experience, and supports multi-target operations.
[*] The fleeing drones have established a new force. They are mining near your base and will harass your surveying rovers from time to time. You need to establish defenses and take the initiative to attack them at the right time to completely eliminate them.
[/olist]


In addition, the next version will also include some minor improvements, such as the balance of the resource, the simplified operation of deploying drones, etc., which will not be listed here. At that time, it will be explained in detail in the update announcement.

Thank you again for your enthusiasm and feedback! Reshaping Mars is better because of you!
